name: form-alerts
description: Posts each form submission to Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat or Telegram as it arrives, with the fields you choose and a link to it in your admin.

forms.title: Forms to alert on
forms.description: Form slugs, one per line. Empty means all forms.

fields.title: Fields to include
fields.description: Field keys, one per line. Empty means all fields except those whose key contains password, token or card.

include_values.title: Include field values
include_values.description: On: the chosen fields and their values are sent. Off: only the form name and the admin link are sent, so no submitted value leaves your site.

max_value_length.title: Longest value
max_value_length.description: Values longer than this many characters are cut and end with an ellipsis. Between 20 and 2000.

admin_url.title: Admin address
admin_url.description: Your admin address, for example https://example.com/admin. Must start with https://. Used for the link to each submission. Leave empty to send the submission id without a link.

slack_webhook_url.title: Slack webhook URL
slack_webhook_url.description: Must start with https://hooks.slack.com/. Stored here and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored value.

teams_workflow_url.title: Teams workflow URL
teams_workflow_url.description: The HTTP POST URL of a Workflows webhook. Must start with https:// and be on logic.azure.com or environment.api.powerplatform.com. Stored here and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored value.

gchat_webhook_url.title: Google Chat webhook URL
gchat_webhook_url.description: Must start with https://chat.googleapis.com/v1/spaces/ and contain /messages?. Stored here and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored value.

telegram_bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_bot_token.description: The token from @BotFather, like 123456:ABC-DEF... Stored here and never shown again. Leave empty to keep the stored value.

telegram_chat_id.title: Telegram chat
telegram_chat_id.description: The numeric chat id, for example -1001234567890, or @channelname for a public channel. Leave empty to turn Telegram off.
